“

Double-click to trade Fractal Relics for something useful.
You can only buy one item per day.

— In-game description

The Fractal Reliquary is an item that allows you to trade 25 Fractal Relics for one of four items per day. Upon use, a vendor window opens which allows you to buy an item. After buying one, the list locks until the next day. The available items change every day. Fractal Encryption Key is always the first item option.
